steps.name: Install test tools for constituent 1
steps.run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep

steps.name: Install test tools for constituent 2
steps.run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep

steps.name: Install test tools for constituent 3
steps.run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep

steps.name: Require every bundled constituent to succeed
steps.run:
status=0
check_slot() {
  local kind="$1" pr="$2" integration="$3"
  if [[ -z "$kind" ]]; then
    [[ "$pr" == skipped && "$integration" == skipped ]] || status=1
  elif [[ "$kind" == pr ]]; then
    [[ "$pr" == success && "$integration" == skipped ]] || status=1
  elif [[ "$kind" == integration ]]; then
    [[ "$pr" == skipped && "$integration" == success ]] || status=1
  else
    status=1
  fi
}
check_slot "$SLOT1_KIND" "$SLOT1_PR" "$SLOT1_INTEGRATION"
check_slot "$SLOT2_KIND" "$SLOT2_PR" "$SLOT2_INTEGRATION"
check_slot "$SLOT3_KIND" "$SLOT3_PR" "$SLOT3_INTEGRATION"
exit "$status"

steps.name: Install and run release durability smoke
Install cross-compilation tools
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu
echo "CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER=aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Free disk space
steps.run:
df -h /
sudo docker image prune -a -f || true
sudo docker system prune -a -f --volumes || true
sudo rm -rf /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL /opt/hostedtoolcache/go /opt/az /opt/ghc \
  /usr/local/lib/android /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/share/boost
df -h /
# The CLI's staged classification proof needs `rg` (and `jq`, preinstalled).
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq ripgrep
rg --version
jq --version

steps.name: Run shard (one test process per test binary, one test thread)
steps.run:
mkdir -p shard-out
start=$(date +%s)
args=()
if [[ "${{ matrix.standalone }}" == "true" ]]; then
  args+=(--manifest-path crates/contextdb-redb/Cargo.toml)
else
  args+=(-p "${{ matrix.crate }}")
fi
if [[ -n "${{ matrix.features }}" ]]; then
  args+=(--features "${{ matrix.features }}")
fi
set +e
# Test-harness targets get the one-thread flag. Benches are run
# separately without it: a `harness = false` (criterion) bench
# rejects libtest arguments such as `--test-threads`.
cargo test --locked "${args[@]}" --lib --bins --tests --examples -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.log"
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
cargo test --locked "${args[@]}" --benches 2>&1 | tee -a "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.log"
bench_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
if [[ "$status" -eq 0 ]]; then status=$bench_status; fi
set -e
end=$(date +%s)
echo "${{ matrix.shard }} $((end - start))s exit=$status" > "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.time"
df -h / | tee -a "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.time"
exit "$status"

steps.name: Require every correctness job to succeed
Disk and per-shard wall clock
steps.run:
df -h
echo "== per-shard wall clock =="
for f in shards/*/*.time; do head -n 1 "$f"; done | sort
